alarm.toggle: Alarm widget: tooltip of the bell button and a right-click item with a checkmark when on. Turns the alarm on or off. 1 to 3 words.
alarm.edit: Alarm widget: tooltip on the big time. Clicking it opens a time field. Short hint, 'action: result' style in Korean.
alarm.repeat_menu: Alarm right-click submenu that lists Once and the seven weekdays to repeat on. One word.
alarm.once: Alarm repeat submenu item: ring one time, then turn off. Checked when no weekday is picked. 1 to 2 words.
alarm.daily: Alarm widget, small line under the time when every weekday is picked. 1 to 2 words.
alarm.weekdays: Alarm widget, small line under the time when Monday to Friday are picked. One word.
alarm.weekends: Alarm widget, small line under the time when Saturday and Sunday are picked. One word.
alarm.ringing: Title of the flash and Windows notification when an alarm rings. The body is the alarm time. One word.
alarm.caption: Sound caption (Settings › Hearing) while the alarm rings. {n} is the current ring, {total} how many it rings. Ends with how to stop it.
alarm.caption_muted: Sound caption when the alarm goes off with the timer sound turned off. Ends with how to dismiss it.
sum.alarm_on: Screen reader summary of an Alarm widget that is on. {time} is the alarm time (e.g. 7:00 AM). Short.
sum.alarm_off: Screen reader summary of an Alarm widget that is off. {time} is the set time. Short.
hint.alarm: Usage hint for the Alarm widget (opt-in, Settings › Accessibility). Same style as the other hint.* keys.
